scripts.docker:setup: cp -n docker/.env.example docker/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n backend/.env.example backend/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n apps/admin/.env.example apps/admin/.env 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n apps/timesheet/.env.example apps/timesheet/.env 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:setup && docker compose --env-file docker/.env up -d
scripts.docker:up:build: npm run docker:setup && docker compose --env-file docker/.env up -d --build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:fast && npm run lint:structure
scripts.lint:fast: npm run lint --workspaces && cd backend && composer lint
scripts.lint:structure: npm run lint:deps && npm run lint:dup
scripts.lint:dup: jscpd --config .jscpd.json apps/admin/src apps/timesheet/src packages/api-client/src packages/ui/src packages/test-utils/src backend/app
scripts.lint:frontend: node_modules/.bin/oxlint apps/admin/src apps/timesheet/src packages/api-client/src packages/ui/src packages/test-utils/src packages/vite-config/src
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspaces && cd backend && composer test:coverage
scripts.precommit: npm run lint:fast && npm run typecheck
scripts.prepush: npm run lint && npm run lint:dup:tests && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage --workspaces && (cd backend && composer test:behat && composer test:coverage && composer test:arch && composer analyse) && npm run build:admin && npm run build:timesheet
scripts.qa: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:behat && npm run build:admin && npm run build:timesheet
scripts.validate:thresholds: npm run test:coverage --workspaces && (cd backend && composer test:coverage && composer test:mutation) && npm run test:mutation:frontend
